# Application protocols {#sec-application-protocols}

An application protocol (AP) is the part of ISO 10303 that turns the generic resources into something a CAD system can implement.
It defines the scope, the information requirements, and a concrete EXPRESS schema whose name appears in the `FILE_SCHEMA` header entity.

## The protocols you will encounter

| AP | Title | Status |
|---:|-------|--------|
| 203 | Configuration controlled 3D design of mechanical parts and assemblies | Superseded by AP 242 |
| 214 | Core data for automotive mechanical design processes | Superseded by AP 242 |
| 242 | Managed model-based 3D engineering | Current, edition 3 published 2022 [@iso10303-242] |

: Common application protocols for mechanical CAD {#tbl-aps}

Files conforming to AP 203 and AP 214 remain in circulation and every serious importer still reads them.
AP 242 merges the two and adds semantic PMI, tessellated geometry, kinematics, and other capabilities.
